subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should Discord retain channel-level retries if https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 lands shared reply-session self-healing?
rationale: Both mechanisms recover the same named conflict at different ownership layers, and code evidence alone cannot determine the intended permanent layering and latency policy.

options.title: Use shared recovery only
options.body: Prefer one root-level recovery path and close or narrow this PR if Discord-specific retry adds no distinct resilience.

options.title: Keep layered recovery
options.body: Retain both only after bounding total recovery latency and proving one Discord inbound event produces exactly one reply.

recommendation.title: Use shared recovery only
recommendation.body: Prefer one root-level recovery path and close or narrow this PR if Discord-specific retry adds no distinct resilience.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history connects this person to both the Discord delivery state machine and shared session lifecycle.
